verdict.rationale: The CRA's own pages state that a founder can register online through Business Registration Online (BRO). One form covers the business number plus GST/HST, payroll and corporate income tax accounts, and BRO calls itself 'the fastest and easiest way'. The e-services pages also list filing a return, making a payment and registering a business online. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that the online flow completes end-to-end for founders (all evidence is first-party claims).
